description: The same change task in a second language, so a prompt or policy change that only works for Go is caught.
title: Add dateparse.is_weekend
prompt: Add a function `is_weekend(value: str) -> bool` to dateparse/parse.py returning True when the ISO date falls on a Saturday or Sunday, and export it from dateparse/__init__.py. Add tests for it in tests/test_parse.py covering a Saturday, a Sunday and a Wednesday.
